{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast bias when sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.25 or 0.50) — model tends to overreact.",
    "Adjust downward for forecasts that overshoot recent highs — especially after spikes in price or sentiment.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5–10%.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is neutral or positive but price is trending downward — avoid overconfidence.",
    "For horizon > 15 days, reduce forecast volatility — model tends to overestimate short-term momentum.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.50, reduce forecast by 3–5% to account for potential market correction.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, apply a 2–3% downward adjustment to next forecast.",
    "Avoid forecasting sharp upward moves when recent history shows downward trend — model overestimates reversal."
  ]
}
